instantiated_cells.justification: Texas requires monthly activity reports by default, with an annual modified reporting option for low-spend registrants.

Section 305.006 requires each registrant (lobbyist) to file the activities report with expenditures categorized (transportation/lodging, food/beverages, entertainment, gifts, awards/mementos, fundraisers), and Section 305.0061 requires further itemization (name of legislator, date, place, purpose) for amounts exceeding thresholds.
Section 305.007(a) requires the registrant to file the activity report between the 1st and 10th day of each month covering the previous month.

Section 305.006(d) requires the registrant's report to list specific categories of subject matters communicated about and to include the administrative action number or designation if known; this is filed by the lobbyist/registrant.

Section 305.005(f)(6) requires the registrant to disclose the amount of compensation or reimbursement paid by each person who reimburses/retains/employs the registrant, reported in the categories specified in subsection (g).

Section 305.0061 requires the registrant to disclose the name of the member of the legislative or executive branch on whose behalf expenditures exceeding thresholds were made, effectively disclosing contacts with named officials.

Section 305.006(b) requires expenditures categorized by type (transportation, food, etc.) and 305.006(d) requires a list of subject matters, but expenditures are not required to be broken down per issue/subject.

Section 305.006(d) requires the registrant's activity report to list specific categories of subject matters about which the registrant communicated directly with members of the legislative or executive branch.
Section 305.006(d) requires the registrant (lobbyist) to file a list of specific subject matter categories communicated about, including administrative action numbers if known.

Section 305.006(b) requires the registrant's report to include expenditures in categories for transportation and lodging, food and beverages, entertainment, gifts, awards and mementos, and political fundraisers/charity events.

Section 305.006(c) requires the registrant to list total expenditures for broadcast or print advertisements, direct mailings, and other mass media communications that support or oppose legislation/administrative action—indirect lobbying costs.

Lobbyists must file itemized spending reports including name of employer/client (§305.005(f)(3)), subject matter and administrative action designation (§305.006(d)), compensation amounts (§305.005(f)(6)), and itemized expenditures (§§305.006(b), 305.0061).
Section 305.005(f)(1)-(2) requires the registrant to disclose full name and address, and normal business, business phone number, and business address.
Section 305.006(d) requires the registrant to list the specific categories of subject matters communicated about, including administrative action numbers — corresponding to Tier 0/1 disclosure.

The registration disclosure requirements list names/addresses and (for groups/non-public corporations) governance details, but do not require disclosure of whether the principal's business is public or private as such.
Section 305.005(f)(3) requires the full name and address of each person who reimburses, retains, or employs the registrant, and on whose behalf the registrant communicates.
Section 305.005(f)(3) requires the registrant (lobbyist) to disclose the full name and address of each person who reimburses, retains, or employs them and on whose behalf they communicate.

The statute requires disclosure of "subject matter" of legislation and administrative action docket numbers, but does not require specific bill numbers for legislation — only the subject matter and (for administrative action) the docket number.

Section 305.005(f)(6) requires the registrant to disclose the amount of compensation or reimbursement paid by each person who reimburses, retains, or employs the registrant — direct lobbying compensation.

Section 305.006(b) requires the registrant's report to contain the total expenditures (in categories) made to communicate directly with members of the legislative or executive branch to influence legislation or administrative action.

Texas lobbyists (registrants) file itemized spending reports under §§305.006 and 305.0061 that include employer names (§305.005(f)(3)), subject matters (§305.006(d)), and compensation (§305.005(f)(6)).

Section 305.007(a) requires each registrant to file the monthly activities report without exception for zero activity; Section 305.008 requires affirmative termination filing to cease the obligation, implying registrants with no activity must still file periodic reports.

Section 305.006(b) covers expenditures attributable to immediate family of legislators/executive members, and §305.0062(a)(6) and (c) require expenditures benefiting immediate family members to be aggregated and reported in a separate category; "immediate family" is defined as spouse or dependent child in §305.002(11).

Section 305.006(b) requires categorized (itemized by type) reporting, and §305.0061 requires further itemization with named legislator, date, place, purpose, and amount for expenditures exceeding thresholds — not merely an aggregated lump sum.

- Sec. 305.006: Activities report by registrant (lobbyist) with categorized expenditures
- Sec. 305.0061: Detailed reports including identification of legislator
- Sec. 305.0062: Includes immediate family expenditures
